hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path');let d=process.cwd();while(!fs.existsSync(p.join(d,'scripts/agent-document-hook.mjs'))){const parent=p.dirname(d);if(parent===d){console.error('Repository document hook not found');process.exit(2)}d=parent}import(require('node:url').pathToFileURL(p.join(d,'scripts/agent-document-hook.mjs')).href).then(m=>m.main()).catch(()=>{console.error('Document hook startup failed');process.exitCode=2})"
